title: Remove redundant RFC5234 normative declaration (front matter + inline !)
description: RFC5234 appears in the normative: front matter block AND is referenced inline as {{!RFC5234}} at line 96. The ! inline marker is redundant when the reference is already declared normative in the front matter. Remove the ! from the inline reference to match the style of other normative references in this document.
close_reason: Changed {{\!RFC5234}} to {{RFC5234}} — RFC5234 is already in the normative: front matter block so the \! inline marker was redundant.
